summary.text: Eric Last is the Democratic candidate for Utah House of Representatives District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Lili Bitner (R).
He previously ran for the same seat in 2014 and 2020.

paragraphs.text: Eric Last was the Democratic nominee for Utah House District 17 in 2014, when incumbent Stewart Barlow defeated him with 77.6% of the vote to Last's 22.4%.
Last ran again in 2020, when Barlow defeated him and Jeannette Proctor of the Constitution Party, with Last receiving 25.8%.
In 2026, the June 23 Democratic primary was canceled.
